names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9556, «Димитрий (Казанский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (после 1937).» — so the surname is read from the name link and is part of the form. `fk.mjs` returns no holder for «димитрии казанскии»; the bare «Димитрий» was deliberately not stored, the corpus keeping many dozens of that name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (после 1937).»

attestations.note: The day’s tenth entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 9556 prints the title and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 23 мая (Ростов.) , 4 июля» and nothing else. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line’s year is «после 1937», after 1937, which is not the claim that he died in 1937, and `lib/date-display.js` carries no form for it — the corpus’s own `display` strings run to «1937 or 1938» and «1937–1939» and to nothing open-ended. The reading is recorded here instead. `new-martyr` rests on the «26 января (Новомуч.)» day the name page sets beside his own, which is the general commemoration of the new martyrs of Russia; that page was NOT read, nor was the 23 мая synaxis of the saints of Rostov. `office` is the name page’s «иерей», priest, which the four locale packs carry, against the day line’s «пресвитера». No folder was found for him; the two `-kazansky` folders in the corpus are a Nicholas and a Sergius. azbyka.ru was not read.
